sql: SELECT floor(avg_rank_tier / 10)::int AS rank_bracket, count(*) AS n, avg((duration / 60))::float8 AS avg_minutes FROM public_matches WHERE match_id > (SELECT max(match_id) FROM public_matches) - 100000 AND lobby_type = 7 GROUP BY floor(avg_rank_tier / 10)::int ORDER BY rank_bracket ASC LIMIT 100
